flora: Nodal sheath (biological protective ring with organic tooth-like edges)
Spore-bearing strobilus (terminal cone with organic honeycomb scales)
Emerging vegetative shoot (thick, spear-like spear-head pushing through clay)
Anatomical stem cross-section (showing organic cellular chambers and pith)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; Strictly microscopic or macro-botanical scale; Organic plant tissue textures; Avoid plastic, PVC, or industrial tubing; Avoid landscape-scale environments; Focus on 'fleshy' and 'fibrous' botanical details; Soft-touch, toy-like high-fidelity 3D rendering.

visual_logic.composition: Botanical specimen tile: Top-Left: Close-up of a growth node with its organic jagged sheath; Top-Right: A hero shot of the terminal spore cone; Bottom-Left: A single spear-like green shoot pushing vertically through a red clay crack (macro focus); Bottom-Right: A cross-section of a green stalk showing a ring of organic air-canals and fibrous plant tissue.
visual_logic.ground: Clean, studio-lit backdrop of red Plottier siltstone, ensuring the plant is the only subject.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright diffused daylight with a slight rim-light to emphasize the organic, fibrous edges of the plant tissue.
